description: Pub. 537 (2025), Mortgage more than basis: selling price $9,000, the buyer assumes a $6,000 mortgage; adjusted basis $4,400 plus $600 selling expenses = $5,000 installment sale basis. 'The part of the mortgage that’s more than your installment sale basis is $1,000 ... treated as a payment received in the year of sale. The contract price is $4,000.' Gross profit $4,000, 100% — the $1,000 (line 20) is gain in the year of sale with no cash received.
